text.content:
They protect the people who work the clubs.

Turf: Kabuki and Little China in Watson; Jig-Jig Street in Japantown; a few Little Europe clubs
Known for: Protecting sex workers; street drugs, Virtus and fashion
Leadership: Susie Q
Allies & rivals: At war with the Tyger Claws. The G4 are their "little sisters". The Princesses of Justice send them the cases they can't hold
Hangouts: Lizzie's Bar (#6), the No-Tell Motel (#7), Short Circuit (#55), every dollhouse back door

The Mox formed in 2067, after Tyger Claws killed bar owner Elizabeth "Lizzie" Borden for standing up for her workers. The feud between her bar and the Claws boiled over into three nights of riots across the city, as sex workers, sexual minorities and their friends stood together and razed Claw establishments. Out of the riots came a gang that fights to protect the sex workers of Night City. Danger Gal detective Minako Arasaka proved the Claws did it, and gave the Mox the evidence for free.

They are still headquartered at Lizzie's old club, renamed Lizzie's Bar in her honor, a safe haven for joytoys whose appeal brings in most of the Mox's money. Pink hair, punk leather, very good boots, and Lizzie's face on a patch. Since 2068 Kabuki's Claw-owned dollhouses have either closed or paid the Mox to stay open.

Susie Q will help anyone in trouble once; twice, and you're Mox. The war with the Claws goes on, and some think the new Shinobu may change that.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.26; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 05, 08
